Axiom: Audit and code-review workers are read-only: they return findings and proposed remediations, never edit code, specs, tickets, or commits. After operator approval, the orchestrator routes the proposal to the artifact owner: a task phase owns code, the scope/module/infra/interface authoring flow owns semantic spec changes, and the execute orchestrator owns only its explicitly bounded administrative ticket / Decision Log channel. Approval changes who may apply the fix; it never makes the reviewer itself an editor.
